regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrow leadership structure: only the top 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible, led by Energy (H-shares) at rank 1 with high durability (0.76, trend tag) and clean breadth (0.8), followed by High-Dividend, Banks, and Conglomerates. Gate discipline has historically helped on this market (gate_helps=true), and the backtest verdict confirms absolute-trend gating as the only validated edge; rotation timing and relative momentum carry no forward claim. With no scorable ETF proxy for any top-ranked theme, I can only lean on the dominant trend theme at low conviction.
emerging_watch: High-Dividend Blue Chips — watching for a confirmed leadership handoff where its score closes the 0.293 margin to Energy and simultaneously its durability stays at or above 0.70 while Energy's durable-trend breadth dips below 0.6; that combination retires the watch by confirming the handoff, while continued clean breadth in Energy keeps the watch open

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only theme where every trust-graded leg is constructive: rank 1, trend-gate eligible, highest durability (0.76, hurst trend), and broad participation (0.8 breadth) with no crowding flag (z=0.36). The validated gate leg supports staying with the trend to avoid shake-out exits; momentum rank is only a focus lens, not an alpha signal, so the lean rests on durable, non-crowded trend structure rather than on the score.
theses.dissent: Energy is energy: exposed to H-share cyclicality and global oil/policy shifts. The high durability is coincident, not predictive — a sharp macro reversal would unwind the trend quickly, and with no ETF proxy the theme is hard to verify in real time. Narrow eligible breadth (only 4 of 17) also limits the theme's structural support.
